copyResult.scope: Actual shared-C cached and uncached rectangular copy through trusted CtrlC into a pre-loader owned memory Promise writer. Exact NULL/zero-byte text/literal NULL/quoted text/apostrophe TSV, unresolved versus terminal ownership, Promise rejection/synchronous failure/unavailable writer and recovery. A captured pending review snapshot stays pinned across platform fulfillment and is adopted after normal cancellation. Real query Apply creates 600 rows; actual page coverage proves uncached cells and exactly one official Worker kind9 supplies complete TSV. Workbook/selection/statistics/cache and idle query ownership remain intact. No OS clipboard, native clipboard, physical typing, saved reports, Table/Pivot copy or export acceptance.
